trigger: User supplied four PDFs (Baym 1971, Chabanat 1998, Glendenning 1991, Typel 1999) and asked whether they unblock C6B.

uploaded_pdfs.citation: G. Baym, H. A. Bethe, C. J. Pethick, Nucl. Phys. A 175, 225-271 (1971)
uploaded_pdfs.role: BPS compressible-liquid-drop outer/inner crust framework (1971). Establishes the lattice-of-nuclei in a free-neutron-gas picture and the Thomas-Fermi surface treatment. Predates CompOSE and the SPG/GPPVA inner-crust models.
uploaded_pdfs.c6b_relevance: Does not document eos.compo row grammar, the Iphase categorical index, Abar/Zav/Y_I/Y_h normalization, or the meaning of the final group field. C6B unaffected.

uploaded_pdfs.citation: E. Chabanat, P. Bonche, P. Haensel, J. Meyer, R. Schaeffer, Nucl. Phys. A 635, 231-256 (1998) Part II
uploaded_pdfs.role: SLy4 Skyrme force parameterization. Documents the effective interaction fit to finite nuclei.
uploaded_pdfs.c6b_relevance: Documents the Skyrme force, not the RG_SLY4 EOS cluster export. The RG_SLY4 model uses the SLy4 force but is a separate EOS (Gulminelli & Raduta, PRC 92 055803 2015, arXiv:1504.04493). C6B unaffected.

uploaded_pdfs.citation: N. K. Glendenning, S. A. Moszkowski, Phys. Rev. Lett. 67, 2414 (1991)
uploaded_pdfs.role: Reconciliation of neutron-star masses and Lambda binding in hypernuclei. Bounds hyperon-induced neutron-star mass reduction.
uploaded_pdfs.c6b_relevance: This is NOT the GM1 RMF parameterization paper. The bibliography already mapped this PRL to GM_GM1, but the GM1 EOS parameter set is established in a separate Glendenning RMF EOS reference. Confirm the exact GM1 parameter citation against the GM_GM1 eos.pdf data sheet before claiming GM_GM1 provenance is fully secured. C6B unaffected (composition not addressed).

uploaded_pdfs.citation: S. Typel, H. H. Wolter, Nucl. Phys. A 656, 331 (1999)
uploaded_pdfs.role: Density-dependent meson-nucleon coupling RMF framework (TW99). Basis for DD-ME2, DD2, NL3, TW parameterizations.
uploaded_pdfs.c6b_relevance: Core-EOS framework paper for several GPPVA core models. Does not address inner-crust cluster composition or the disputed final group field. C6B unaffected.

verdict: The four user-supplied PDFs do NOT resolve the C6B blocker.
reason: C6B requires (1) a written provider definition for the final group field in SPG/GPPVA eos.compo rows - whether it encodes Y_I, Y_h, X_h, a charge fraction, a free-neutron-gas fraction, or another aggregate - and (2) independent closure (Y_n + Y_p + Y_h = 1 and Y_p + (Zbar/Abar) Y_h = Y_e + Y_mu) per row. The four uploaded papers address framework, force parameterization, hypernuclear binding, and the RMF functional form. None documents the CompOSE eos.compo row grammar, the Iphase categorical index, the Abar/Zav/Y_I/Y_h convention for a cluster group, or the meaning of the disputed final group field.
